name: Wanted: DWARVES!
label: Quest
description: Wanted: DWARVES!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By order of Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl, all dwarves on the field of battle are to be killed on sight.
Should you slay a dwarf in combat, rip out their spine, leaving a spineless heap of stink and rot to serve as a warning to any and all that dare oppose the might of the Frostwolf.
Return to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl with proof of your heroics.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I deal in wholesale irony, soldier.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You now have license to decimate dwarves by the dozen, adventurer!
You never forget your first de-spining...
